messages:
mike: Quick thread — need a concise DP (design partner) acceptance anchor for roadmap review Monday. Exec wants: clear recruitment criteria, launch readiness checklist, and escalation paths. Can we sketch something today?

sara: I can draft the acceptance anchor. My top-level thought: must be measurable, lightweight for partners, and reversible (easy to pause/remove).

elaine: From research: partners care most about time-to-value and integration effort. Recommend we include: target time to first successful integration (<2 weeks), at least one in-product workflow validated, and net-promoter style confidence score >7.

devon: Incentives question — do we offer credits only, or also prioritized product support? Suggest: tiered incentive (credits + 2 prioritized bugs triaged/month). That makes partners feel heard and gives us operational signals.

lex: Legal note: for private DPs we need comms around data handling and export rights. I'll draft a one-paragraph blurb for the invite mentioning archival window and KMS handling.

ops-bot: heads-up: onboarding automation template exists: /ops/templates/dp-onboard-checklist.md. Can auto-send when partner signs SOW.

pm-bot: Calendar reminder set for "DP roadmap review prep" Mon 10:00 PT.

mike: Thanks. Let's align on the minimum acceptance criteria set (what we show exec). My draft proposal: Engagement, Integration, Feedback Quality, Ops readiness.

sara: Proposal (compact):
- Engagement: >= 2 active sessions/week OR >= 20 API calls/week for 3 of 4 weeks.
- Integration: working integration that executes main workflow end-to-end within 14 days.
- Feedback Quality: 1 structured eval + 2 qualitative notes per sprint (2 weeks).
- Ops readiness: SLO <= 200ms P95 on dev traffic, runbook created, and support channel established.

elaine: Add churn signal: if partner drops below engagement for 2 weeks, ops-trigger a check-in. Also capture sentiment trend from evals.

devon: For recruitment gating, suggest categories: "strategic" (co-build, exec sponsor), "high-value" (large potential spend), "fast-feedback" (small integration, high velocity). Ask partners to self-select and we score.

mike: Nice. We should also include exit/eviction policy and a lightweight rehabilitation flow. Draft snippet below:```
{
  "eviction": {
    "trigger": "engagement_below_threshold_2weeks OR critical_regression",
    "notice_days": 7,
    "archive_window_days": 30,
    "rehab": {"required_good_weeks": 2, "monitoring_period_weeks": 4}
  }
}
```

lex: That looks fine. I'll add the legal blurb and the required notice language (and KMS caveats for private deployments).

sara: Ops/Infra asks: do we have a dashboard tile and an automated alert for DP cohort thresholds? @ops-bot

ops-bot: Can create tile. Need owners for metrics: engagement (product telemetry), api_calls (ingest team), eval_regressions (evals pipeline). Please tag owners in ticket.

devon: I'll build the recruitment scorecard (simple CSV scoring columns) and a templated outreach email. Suggest A/B subject lines for higher response.

mike: Who owns what?
- sara: acceptance anchor doc + dashboard tile mock
- devon: recruitment scorecard + outreach templates
- elaine: partner interview script + structured eval template
- lex: legal blurb + eviction wording
- ops-bot / ops: automation + ticket to build tile

sara: I'll post a short doc in /product/dp-acceptance-anchor.md and attach the dashboard mock. Plan: circulate to exec by Fri COB if everyone signs off.

elaine: Quick check: success KPIs for exec slide (keep to 3): activation time, qualitative signal (NPS/confidence), and reduction in regressions per release.

devon: Agree. Also include a leading metric: # of structured evals submitted/week.

mike: Cool. Action items: owners above, review draft in this thread by EOD Thu. I'll consolidate into the slide deck after sign-off. :thumbsup:
